label: Fantasy Folk Portrait
description: A portrait of one of the peoples of fantasy — elf, dwarf, orc, fae, tiefling — treated as a person rather than a monster. Build and bearing come from creature/folk; everything else is ordinary portraiture, which is exactly what makes it land.
prefix: A portrait of {folk}, {expression}, painted with the seriousness of a court portrait.
suffix: Portrait Rendering: (anatomy of the folk held consistently — ear set, jaw, proportion, skin:1.3), (dignity and interiority, a person rather than a creature study:1.25), (perfect hands, detailed fingers:1.2), controlled dramatic light, background subordinate to the face.
negative: monster, grotesque, cartoon, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, text, logo, child, chibi, underage
